<script type="module">
const { h: __h, T, Fragment: __Fragment } = befui;
const Avatar = T.Avatar;
const Badge = T.Badge;
const Button = T.Button;
const TruncatedText = T.TruncatedText;

const tone = { Active: 'success', 'On leave': 'warning', Notice: 'danger' };
const date = (d) => new Date(d).toLocaleDateString('en-IN', { day: '2-digit', month: 'short', year: 'numeric' });
const columns = [
    { key: 'name', header: 'Name', sortable: true, value: (p) => p.name, render: (p) => __h("span", { className: "flex items-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap" },
            __h(Avatar, { name: p.name, size: "sm" }),
            p.name) },
    { key: 'email', header: 'Email', value: (p) => p.email, render: (p) => __h(TruncatedText, { className: "w-36 text-muted-foreground" }, p.email) },
    { key: 'team', header: 'Team', sortable: true, value: (p) => p.team },
    { key: 'joined', header: 'Joined', sortable: true, value: (p) => p.joined, render: (p) => __h("span", { className: "whitespace-nowrap text-muted-foreground" }, date(p.joined)) },
    { key: 'salary', header: 'Salary', sortable: true, align: 'right', value: (p) => p.salary, render: (p) => `₹${(p.salary / 100000).toFixed(1)}L` },
    { key: 'status', header: 'Status', value: (p) => p.status, render: (p) => __h(Badge, { variant: tone[p.status], dot: true }, p.status) },
];

document.getElementById("g1").props = {
  columns: [
    {
      key: "name",
      header: "Name",
      sortable: true,
      value: (p) => p.name,
      render: (p) => __h("span", { className: "flex items-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap" }, __h(T.Avatar, { name: p.name, size: "sm" }), p.name),
    },
    {
      key: "email",
      header: "Email",
      value: (p) => p.email,
      render: (p) => __h(T.TruncatedText, { className: "w-36 text-muted-foreground" }, p.email),
    },
    { key: "team", header: "Team", sortable: true, value: (p) => p.team },
    {
      key: "joined",
      header: "Joined",
      sortable: true,
      value: (p) => p.joined,
      render: (p) => __h("span", { className: "whitespace-nowrap text-muted-foreground" }, date(p.joined)),
    },
    {
      key: "salary",
      header: "Salary",
      sortable: true,
      align: "right",
      value: (p) => p.salary,
      render: (p) => `₹${(p.salary / 1e5).toFixed(1)}L`,
    },
    {
      key: "status",
      header: "Status",
      value: (p) => p.status,
      render: (p) => __h(T.Badge, { variant: tone[p.status], dot: true }, p.status),
    },
  ],
  rowKey: (p) => p.id,
  bulkActions: (rows, clear) => __h(__Fragment, null, __h(T.Button, { size: "xs", variant: "outline", onClick: clear }, "Export ", rows.length), __h(T.Button, { size: "xs", variant: "ghost", onClick: clear }, "Clear")),
};
</script>
